2026-11-22.meal: Veggie chickpea & spinach curry with rice
2026-11-22.note: Free day — a good one to batch-cook extra for Wednesday's Hockey Academy Night.

steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, chopped tomatoes and stock. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring now and then.
Take out Mathilda's portion and 4 portions to cool for Wednesday before seasoning the rest.
Stir the spinach into the remainder and cook for 3–4 minutes until wilted.
Cook the rice and serve with the curry.
Cool Wednesday's 4 portions within an hour, cover and keep in the fridge.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: keep hers mild — no curry powder in her portion, just the chickpeas and veg.

2026-11-23.note: Nursery photo day for Mathilda this morning — evening's free, a new one to try.

ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into small florets
100g grated cheddar, plus extra for the topping
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the pasta 2 minutes less than the pack says, then drain.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 3–4 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Put the salmon in a pan, cover with the milk and poach gently for 6–8 minutes until just cooked. Lift out the salmon and flake it, keeping the milk.
Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the reserved milk. Simmer for 3–4 minutes until thickened, then stir in most of the cheese and the mustard.
Mix the pasta, broccoli and flaked salmon into the sauce. Take out Mathilda's portion now, checking carefully for stray bones.
Tip into an ovenproof dish, scatter over the rest of the cheese, and bake for 15–20 minutes until bubbling and golden.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: flake her salmon extra small and double-check for bones before mixing it through her portion.

2026-11-24.meal: Air-fryer breaded fish fillets with mash, peas & sweetcorn
2026-11-24.note: Hull hockey training 6–7pm (Hymers College) plus travel — air fryer gets tea done fast either side.

ingredients: 4 servings mash (fresh potatoes, or microwave pouches for speed)
Butter & milk, for the mash (if making fresh)
steps: Air fry the fish fillets at 190°C for 12–14 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and piping hot.
If making fresh mash, boil chunked potatoes for 15 minutes, drain, then mash with butter and a splash of milk.
Cook the peas and sweetcorn in a pan of boiling water for 4–5 minutes, or microwave.
Drain and serve everything together.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: cut her fillet into pieces and check it's not too hot. Microwave mash pouches work well if it's been a long day.

2026-11-25.meal: Reheat: Sunday's chickpea & spinach curry with rice
2026-11-25.note: Hockey Academy Night 6:15–7:45pm (The Lindum) — quick reheat gets tea done either side of the run.

ingredients: 4 portions of Sunday's chickpea & spinach curry (from the fridge)
steps: Tip the curry into a pan with a splash of water.
Heat gently, stirring, until bubbling and piping hot all the way through (about 8–10 minutes). Or microwave in a covered bowl for 4–5 minutes, stirring halfway.
Cook the rice while the curry heats.
Serve straightaway.
recipe.tip: Only reheat it once, and check it's piping hot all the way through before serving. Anyone back late from Academy Night can have theirs microwaved separately.

2026-11-26.meal: Creamy mushroom & butter bean stroganoff with rice
2026-11-26.note: Free evening, nothing on for tea — a new one to try to round off the week.

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, plus a knob of butter
steps: Soften the onion in the oil and butter for 5 minutes. Add the mushrooms and cook for 5–6 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the butter beans and stock and simmer for 8–10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Take out Mathilda's portion now, keeping hers plain.
Stir the crème fraîche through the rest and warm gently for 2–3 minutes — don't let it boil hard or it can split.
Cook the rice while the sauce finishes. Serve the stroganoff over rice, scattered with parsley.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: keep hers without the paprika, and mash a few of the butter beans if she's fussy about texture.
